tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Lesotho Electricity Company issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Lesotho Electricity Company
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Lesotho — managed by Lesotho Electricity Company with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Lesotho Electricity Company issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Lesotho Electricity Company in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 LSL unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Lesotho Electricity Company
description: Lesotho Electricity Company issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Lesotho Electricity Company projects in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Lesotho Electricity Company under government off-take programmes in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by Lesotho Electricity Company under preferential procurement policies in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across Lesotho Electricity Company enterprise operations in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 LSL unit.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Partial State Equity Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional economic interest in Lesotho Electricity Company — Lesotho government retains majority ownership
description: Lesotho Electricity Company issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. The government retains majority control while citizens, pension funds and diaspora investors access ownership stakes from 1 LSL unit, distributing national resource wealth broadly.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company SOE Development Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Sovereign-backed development bond issued by Lesotho Electricity Company to finance capital expansion in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 LSL unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token
underlyingAsset: Financial inclusion initiative of Lesotho Electricity Company targeting unbanked and underserved communities in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company deploys a universal access token to extend its core services to unbanked rural and peri-urban communities. Women's cooperatives, youth groups and disability enterprises receive preferential allocation at issuance, with minimal KYC via mobile digital identity.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Critical Mineral Royalty Token
underlyingAsset: Lesotho critical mineral royalties and production-sharing revenue from Lesotho Electricity Company operations
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company Farmer Verification Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Satellite and IoT verified agricultural output records for farmers supplying Lesotho Electricity Company in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular

tokenName: Lesotho Electricity Company End-to-End Supply Chain Track Token
underlyingAsset: Multi-step supply chain provenance trail from production through to delivery — managed by Lesotho Electricity Company in Lesotho
description: Lesotho Electricity Company tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
regulatoryFramework: Lesotho Public Enterprises Act; CBL Digital Finance Circular
